text: Rose Township Board of Trustees Regular Meeting Agenda October 14, 2026, 7:00 p.m. 9080 Mason Street, Holly, Mi 48442 Order of the meeting Introduction of Agenda Item, Brief Description, Board Discussion, Public Comment, Opportunity for Additional Board Comment, Motion, Vote CALL TO ORDER PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE ROLL CALL - Stilwell, Miller, Jobes, Bordeau, Maher APPROVAL OF AGENDA APPROVAL OF CONSENT AGENDA e Minutes of Regular Board Meeting — 09/09/2026 e Minutes of Monday Meetings — 09/14/2026, 09/28/2026 Note: 9/21/2026 Approved on 9/28/2026 Monday Meeting e Building Department Reports — September 2026 e N.O.C.F.A. — September 2026 e Financial Reports e HAYA e Treasurer's Report - due Quarterly PUBLIC HEARING None PRESENTATIONS — 1. Scott Roper — Holly Area Schools Bond Proposal o Presentation and discussion 2. Matt Weil — North Oakland County Fire Authority (NOCFA) o 2027 NOCFA Budget Presentation Rose Township Board of Trustees [| October 14, 2026 | Page 1 UNFINISHED BUSINESS None NEW BUSINESS 1. Consideration and approval of the North Oakland County Fire Authority (NOCFA) Calendar Year 2027 Budget and Rose Township's 2027 contribution to NOCFA, Proposed Resolution 2026-37 Description: The North Oakland County Fire Authority has presented its proposed Calendar Year 2027 Budget for consideration by the participating municipalities. Under the draft CY 2027 budget, Rose Township's contribution is $1,300,000, compared with the current budget contribution of $1,243,327, representing an increase of $56,673, or approximately 4.6%. The proposed NOCFA budget includes revenues from the participating townships, training and education, medical cost recovery, fire cost recovery, grants, and other sources. The draft budget lists total revenues of $3,118,000 for CY 2027. The Board of Trustees is being asked to approve Rose Township's participation in the NOCFA CY 2027 Budget at the proposed contribution amount of $1,300,000, subject to the final NOCFA budget adopted by the Authority. 2. November 11, 2026 Board Meeting - Consideration of Rescheduling the November 11, 2026 Regular Township Board Meeting Description: due to Veterans Day on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, consider rescheduling the regular Township Board meeting to Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. Board action requested: Approve the change of meeting date from November 11, 2026, to November 18, 2026. 3. Process of Forensic Audit Rose Township Board of Trustees | October 14, 2026 | Page 2 4. Consideration and Appointment of Luke Murchie to the Rose Township Planning Commission Description: Board members, tonight | am bringing forward Luke Murchie for your consideration to fill the vacancy on our Planning Commission following the passing of Mark Bolan. Mark was a long-time member of the Planning Commission who dedicated many years to serving Rose Township. His experience, commitment, and contributions will be missed by all. We recognize his service to our community and the loss we have experienced with his passing. Luke has lived in Rose Township for many years and brings valuable experience in natural resource management, forestry, environmental protection, and public land stewardship through his work with Oakland County Parks and Recreation. His background would bring a practical perspective to our Planning Commission as the Township continues to address land use, development, natural resources, and the long- term interests of our residents. | am asking the Board to consider Luke Murchie for appointment to serve the remainder of Mark Bolan’s term, ending December 31, 2026. | recommend that the Board consider his qualifications and take action on the appointment. 5. Discussion and Consideration of Township Funding for the NOCFA Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Alarm Program, Proposed Resolution 2026-38 Presentation: Chief Matt Weil Description: discussion regarding the continuation of the North Oakland County Fire Authority (NOCFA) smoke and carbon monoxide alarm program following changes to the historically available State of Michigan funding. From 2019 through 2026, NOCFA records report hundreds of alarms distributed and/or installed in homes throughout Holly and Rose Townships. Based on approximate product costs of $30 per carbon monoxide alarm and $45 per smoke alarm, the reported average annual product cost is approximately $3,446.25. An annual program budget of approximately $5,000 has been suggested for consideration. The proposed approach would involve Rose Township and Holly Township sharing the program costs, potentially on a 50/50 basis, with NOCFA purchasing and installing alarms within its response area. Rose Township Board of Trustees | October 14, 2026 | Page 3 Rose Township's potential contribution could be considered for funding through Account 101-225-972-000 — Small Equipment, subject to verification of available budget funds and confirmation that the expenditure is allowable under the account and applicable municipal requirements. The Board is asked to discuss the proposal and determine whether there is sufficient interest to request a formal funding plan outlining the anticipated annual cost, proposed funding split, purchasing process, and program administration. No Township financial commitment is requested at this time. Individuals with disabilities requiring auxiliary aids or services should contact the Rose Township Board of Trustees by contacting the Rose Township Clerk's office, 9080 Mason Street, Holly, MI 48442. Phone: 248-634-8701. Email: clerk@rosetownship.com Rose Township Board of Trustees | October 14, 2026 | Page 5 Rose Township Board of Trustees Meeting MINUTES September 9, 2026 DRAFT Location: 9080 Mason Street, Holly, Ml 48442 CALL TO ORDER - Supervisor Stilwell called the regular meeting to order at 7:00 p.m. ROLL CALL Present: Stilwell, Miller, Jobes, Bourdeau, Maher Absent: None APPROVAL OF AGENDA Supervisor Stilwell stated that under New Business Item #3, Resolution 2026-29 was revised. Copies of the updated resolution were provided. Motion by Trustee Bourdeau to approve the agenda. Supported by Treasurer Jobes. A voice vote was taken. The motion was carried 5/0. APPROVAL OF CONSENT AGENDA Motion by Trustee Bourdeau to approve the Consent Agenda. Supported by Trustee Maher. A roll call vote was taken. Jobes — yes; Stilwell — yes; Maher ~ yes; Miller — yes; Bourdeau — yes. The motion was carried 5/0. PUBLIC HEARING - None PRESENTATION -— Greg Hayes, Director of the Holly Township Library Mr. Hayes thanked Rose Township for its continuing partnership and presented the Library's annual report. He reported approximately $738,000 in annual revenue, including approximately $628,000 from millage revenue, and noted increased participation in teen and children's summer reading and other events. He also highlighted the Library remodeling project, completed without borrowing funds, and the Library's participation in The Library Network (TLN), which expands reciprocal borrowing opportunities for cardholders throughout much of southeast Michigan. The Board and public discussed reciprocal library use, the number of Rose Township residents using the Library, and access to electronic materials through the Libby application. UNFINISHED BUSINESS - None Board of Trustees Meeting 09/09/2026
